mapper.sql: i.id, i.owner_id, u.nickname AS owner, i.category_id, c.name AS category, i.title, i.description, i.campus, i.pickup_location, i.status, i.created_at, (SELECT image_url FROM item_image WHERE item_id=i.id ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1) AS image

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM favorite f WHERE f.item_id=i.id AND f.user_id=#{userId})

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM item i JOIN app_user u ON u.id=i.owner_id JOIN category c ON c.id=i.category_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.status='ON_SHELF' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM item i JOIN app_user u ON u.id=i.owner_id JOIN category c ON c.id=i.category_id WHERE i.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM item i JOIN app_user u ON u.id=i.owner_id JOIN category c ON c.id=i.category_id WHERE i.status='ON_SHELF' AND i.id IN #{id}
